services.desc: Miami Jet Ski Rental is the only jet ski company in Miami to offer a newest top-of-the-line Yamaha WaveRunner fleet. With options like reverse to make docking easier and dual mirrors to check out the others you left behind, you’ll be glad you made Boat Rental Miami your choice. When you arrive at Miami Jet Ski Rental, your jet ski is always ready to go. Just sign the required paperwork, get the safety briefing, and off we go!! Remember to bring picture ID. Miami Jet Ski Rental is proud to offer the NEWEST and BEST jet ski on the water - the Yamaha VX DELUXE. These skis have comfort, power, safety and a new technology that allows for maximum control. The world’s first throttle dual handlebar

blurb: Guests embark on jet ski adventures through Miami's azure waters, seeing Miami and the beaches from a unique perspective. The company offers 1 hour island adventure tours departing at multiple times daily. They provide new Yamaha jet skis and prioritize safety and value with all-inclusive pricing.
